tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs chung ba'i mdangs skong bzhugs so:

bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha la phyag 'tshal lo: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: yang nas yang du snyan du brgyud: gsang sngags mchog gi sgrub pa 'dir: mdangs la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis: rig 'dzin so so'i thugs dam bskang: rdzas ni rin chen sna lnga dang: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang: rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang: rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: rakta dmar gyi rgya mtsho dang: sha chen spos kyi dud pa dang: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang: snang gsal zhun mar mdangs dang ni: mkha' lding bya dang shel sgong lug: tsa ra la sogs mdangs kyis bskang: rol mo sil snyan sgra dang bcas: skong ba'i cho ga 'di skad do: hūm̐: shar nas badzra akṣo bhya: rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las: zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: lho nas ratna saṃ bha trāṃ: rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam las: nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: nub nas padma dhā ra hrī: padma rigs kyi thugs dam las: 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: byang nas a mo siddhi hā: las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam las: phrag dog dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: dbus nas bai ro tsa na oṃ: de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las: gti mug dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: rtsa ba'i dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang: mi spang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: mched dang lcam dral thugs dam bskang: dang blang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: gzung ma rnam rol thugs dam bskang: spyad bya'i dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: dam rdzas lnga yis thugs dam bskang: shes bya'i dam tshig gso ba'i phyir: lta sgom spyod pas thugs dam bskang: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: rnam rtog bag chags sbyong ba'i phyir:

zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dug lnga gnas su dag pa'i phyir: rigs kyi yab lnga'i thugs= 'byung lnga gnas su dag pa'i phyir: rigs kyi yum lnga'i thugs= rnam shes brgyad po gnas dag phyir: sems dpa' brgyad kyi thugs= yul brgyad gnas su dag pa'i phyir: sems ma brgyad kyi thugs= nyon mongs drug po 'joms pa'i phyir: thub pa drug gi thugs= yid dang chos gnyis gnas dag pa'i: kun bzang yab yum thugs= sgo bzhi bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir: sgo ba yab yum thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: khro bo kun gyi che btsan mchog: che mchog lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: khro tshogs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: che mchog yab yum thugs= phrin las bzhi yis don mdzad pa'i: rigs bzhi he ru ka yi thugs= de yi thugs dam skul ba'i phyir: kro tī rigs bzhi'i thugs= phyogs bcu'i gdon rnams 'dul ba'i phyir: khro bcu yab yum thugs= dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= bstan pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir: ce spyang ma brgyad thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ngang las rol pa'i sku: yang dag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dug lnga rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: rigs kyi yab lnga'i thugs= 'byung lnga gnas su dag pa'i phyir: rigs kyi yum lnga'i thugs= rnam shes brgyad po 'joms pa'i phyir: ke'u ri ma brgyad thugs= yul brgyad gnas su dag pa'i phyir: siṃ ha brgyad kyi thugs= tshad med ngo bo yin pa'i phyir: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= bstan pa srung zhing las la myur: dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: drag pos gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: bde gshegs rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku: gshin rje yab yum thugs=

de yis las la 'gyed pa'i phyir: gshed bzhi yab yum thugs= phyogs bcu'i 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyir: khro bcu yab yum thugs= sgo bzhi srung zhing las la myur: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= dam nyams khram la 'debs pa'i phyir: khram thogs bdud kyi thugs= srog la gshed ma bsko ba'i phyir: gri thog ging gi thugs= dgra bo rtsis la gdab pa'i phyir: sho thog rtsis pa'i thugs= dgra snying mngon du phyung ba'i phyir: shan pa bzhi yi thugs= las rnams ma lus sgrub pa'i phyir: las mkhan mon pa'i thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: rta mgrin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: rta mgrin yab yum thugs= dregs pa ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir: byi la pu shud thugs= 'byung po thams cad zil gnon phyir: zil gnon khro brgyad thugs= de yi thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir: zil gnon yum gyi thugs= dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i phyir: dpal gyi bka' nyan thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: dam sri gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: phur pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: snang srid phur pas 'debs pa'i phyir: rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs= gtso bo'i thugs dam skul ba'i phyir: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs thugs= dug lnga'i bdud 'dul khro bo'i rgyal: rigs lnga kī la ya'i thugs= thugs rje'i thabs kyis thams cad 'dul: ta kṛta khro bcu'i thugs= skye med chos sku'i byin rlabs las: khro mo bcu yi thugs= sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ste: za byed pha bcu'i thugs= bka' nyan pho nya mgyogs byed ma: gsod byed ma bcu'i thugs= phyag rgya bzhi yis don mdzad ma: sgo ma bzhi yi thugs= sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: dpal gyi bka' nyan thugs=

thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: dus min 'chi ba zlog pa'i phyir: ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i phyir: bla med he ru ka yi thugs= gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ma: mu kha le yi thugs= tshe dang srog la dbang mdzad ma: rtag rgyal ma lnga'i thugs= bkrag dang mdangs la dbang sgyur ma: rje mo bcu bzhi'i thugs= dbugs dang rlung la drod nyul ma: dman mo lnga bcu'i thugs= ma mo rnams kyi las mkhan ma: sgo ma bzhi yi thugs= dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: bka' nyan lha tshogs thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: sgrub chen brgyad la dbang sgyur phyir: rig 'dzin brgyad kyi thugs= phrin las bzhi po sgrub pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin bzhi yi thugs= rgyud lung man ngag don ston phyir: snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs= drin la lan gyis blan pa'i phyir: slob dpon bzhi yi thugs= sngar 'das ma 'ongs da ltar bzhugs: dus gsum rig 'dzin thugs= dngos grub char ltar 'beb pa'i phyir: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: 'go ba'i lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir: mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dregs pa las la bkol ba'i phyir: dregs pa kun 'dul thugs= khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyir: khams gsum spyi 'dul thugs= pho rgyud rnams kyi che btsan mchog: dbang phyug chen po'i thugs= mo rgyud rnams kyi che btsan phyir: u ma de bī'i thugs= sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: sde dpon nyer brgyad thugs= sgo bzhi srung ba'i las mdzad pa'i: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐:

zhing bcu'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: dregs pa ma lus zil gnon phyir: stobs ldan nag po'i thugs= mo rgyud thams cad zil gnon phyir: 'byung lnga'i bdag mo'i thugs= gshin rje dmod pa'i drag sngags can: 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs= ma mo dmod pa'i drag sngags can: nag mo khrag 'dzag thugs= bstan srung dmod pa'i drag sngags can: dregs pa bco brgyad thugs= bka' nyan dmod pa'i drag sngags can: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs= thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: phyi rim lcags ri nag po la: dpal gyi bka' sdod srung ma ni: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba'i phyir: dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i phyir: mkha' 'gro sum cu'i thugs= ru tra sde gsum 'dul ba'i phyir: ging dang lang ka'i thugs= thugs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir: 'bar ma brgyad kyi thugs= 'jig rten khams la dbang sgyur phyir: dbang chen sde bzhi'i thugs= sa bdag gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: sa bdag sum cu'i thugs= 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i phyir: ma mo bdun gyi thugs= dam tshig gzhung bzhin srung ba'i phyir: sring mo bzhi yi thugs= phyogs bcur sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir: pho nya drug cu'i thugs= mi nad phyugs nad rgyun bcad phyir: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i thugs= bod khams thams cad skyong ba'i phyir: brtan ma bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: g.yar dam gnyan po sor stsol cig: hūm̐: bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang: mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang: rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang:

rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: rakta dmar gyi mchod pa dang: sha chen spos kyi dam rdzas dang: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang: snang gsal mar me'i mchod pa dang: tsa ra 'di yi mdangs kyis bskang: mkha' lding 'di yi mdangs kyis bskang: shel sgong 'di yi mdangs kyis bskang: 'di ltar bskangs bskangs gsol gsol nas: thugs dam gnyan po des bskangs la: cho ga lhag chad rdzogs gyur cig: bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig: g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen ngan zlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi phyag dpe: mnga' bdag nyang gi gter ma 'o: mdangs skong chung ba yin par 'dug lags so// dge'o/// /
